title: Vision tuning
description: Gameplay tuning owned by the Vision domain (Vision Bible; ADR-016 §9): how often the server works out what each team and player sees, how far each kind of unit sees, the vision tools and presence pings. VeyraVision binds it to FVeyraVisionTuning.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's format. A build reads exactly one version.

update.description: How often vision is worked out on the server (ADR-016 §2). Targeting and replication read the same pass, so they always agree.

provenance.description: Where these values come from (ADR-008 §7). Canon gives none; provisional answers stand in (ADR-016 §11).

updateSeconds.description: Seconds between two passes; a unit stepping into sight shows at most this late.

sight.description: How far each kind of unit sees, in units (Vision Bible §1). Wildlife gives no vision.

provenance.description: Where these values come from (ADR-008 §7). Canon gives none; provisional answers stand in (ADR-016 §11).

structure.description: A structure's sight radius: Spires, base towers, inhibitors and the Prime Well.

ward.description: A placed ward's sight radius (Vision Bible §4). Inside Dense Fog it sees no enemy Vanguard; it senses presence instead.

companion.description: A Vanguard's companion's sight radius (ADR-034 §4); a banished one sees nothing.

wardCharges.description: The Persistent Ward's carried charges (Vision Bible §4): a cap on charges carried, not on wards placed.

provenance.description: Where these values come from (ADR-008 §7). Canon gives three.

max.description: Charges carried at most; a Vanguard starts with them all.

persistentWard.description: The Persistent Ward and the wards it places (Vision Bible §4, §9; ADR-016 §6).

provenance.description: Where these values come from (ADR-008 §7). Canon gives none; provisional answers stand in (ADR-016 §11).

rechargeSeconds.description: Seconds for one charge to come back while fewer than the most are carried.

lifetimeSeconds.description: Seconds a placed ward lasts unless it is destroyed first.

placementRange.description: How far from its Vanguard a ward is placed; a point further away is brought back within it.

hitsToDestroy.description: Basic attacks from enemy Vanguards that destroy a ward, whatever their damage.

bodyRadius.description: The radius of a ward's body, which a player clicks to attack it.

bodyHalfHeight.description: Half the height of a ward's body; at least its radius.

sensorRadius.description: Inside Dense Fog, how far around a ward an enemy Vanguard sets off its presence ping (Vision Bible §4): its own coverage, not the whole fog.

sweeper.description: Sweeper (Vision Bible §5): True Sight around its owner, for all its team.

provenance.description: Where these values come from (ADR-008 §7). Canon gives none; provisional answers stand in (ADR-016 §11).

radius.description: How far around its owner it reveals Invisible units and outlines Vanguards in Dense Fog.

cooldownSeconds.description: Seconds before it can be used again; swaps and deaths never shorten it (§7).

outlineLingerSeconds.description: How long an outline lingers after True Sight stops covering it.

quickSight.description: Quick Sight (Vision Bible §6): ordinary vision over an area for a moment; over Dense Fog, a presence sensor.

provenance.description: Where these values come from (ADR-008 §7). Canon gives none; provisional answers stand in (ADR-016 §11).

range.description: How far from its Vanguard it reaches; a point further away is brought within it.

cooldownSeconds.description: Seconds before it can be used again; swaps and deaths never shorten it (§7).

presence.description: Presence pings (Vision Bible §4, §6; ADR-016 §5): what a sensor reports of an enemy Vanguard in Dense Fog.

provenance.description: Where these values come from (ADR-008 §7). Canon gives none; provisional answers stand in (ADR-016 §11).

pingEverySeconds.description: How often a sensor pings again while an enemy Vanguard stays in its coverage.
